testcase.name: a queued delete drops queued updates but keeps the create
tombstone wins answer is recorded as a conflict and consumes the op
retry keeps the same opId and bumps attempts
an update after a queued delete is discarded and a second delete is a no-op
ops are drained oldest first and keep per-entry order
a local tombstone is kept until the server catches up
stale baseVersion is applied by the server and recorded locally as a conflict
unknown entries from a pull are inserted clean and stale pages are ignored
transient failures retry with the same key, permanent rejections drop the op
a duplicate opId answer is a success, not a conflict
a server tombstone wins over local edits and drops everything queued for that entry
a failed entry blocks only its own later ops
server fields replace local ones when nothing else is queued
a cursor older than the tombstone retention forces a full pull
local fields are kept while more ops are queued, but the version advances
